rules.area: KEEP all creatures in30ft radius; NEW fixed sphere centered at one perceived point within native30ft and LoE. Resolve each actual recipient independently with a NEW CHA save against this actual class/school DC; success no display, failure the information procedure below. No empty-target benefit proc or hidden-membership prompt.
rules.truth: Extend the exact accepted single-target reader only to this source. Read the current effective Lawful/Neutral/Chaotic and Good/Neutral/Evil axes independently, never infer a value from behavior,creature type,reputation,belief or base history. Evaluate actual lower records and exact AP-AS-01/AC4-ALIGN-01 rules, including operative Lock/Anchor snapshot last within their accepted scope. A display mask is not an alignment change; only its exact accepted reader-masking permission can alter output. Undefined or actually protected axes return Indeterminate; do not disclose why. A total information protection may therefore leave two Indeterminate sigils without revealing protected values. No cleanse,ward-piercing,restored baseline or hidden original alignment.
rules.display: On failed save create two nonlinguistic sigils immediately around that same body only for the resolution instant, long enough for ordinary observation. NEW reuse the reviewed observer gate: each observer must actually see the body or possess an exact source-authorized sense that can read this display. The sigils emit no useful surrounding light and grant no sight/location of Hidden,Invisible,darkness-concealed or opaque-covered bodies. Blind observers learn nothing through this source. An outside-area observer can read a visible recipient; caster gets no private roster or special diagnostic. Record only lawfully observed axis values attached to the already perceived body; no new true name,motive,criminal history,forced speech,oath or faction consequence. Display ends; remembered information remains.
rules.protections: Current index marks Alignment Immunity and Mind Blank already applied, superseding the historical question wording. Their exact accepted procedure/receipt hashes are listed in the live index but their operational envelopes are not included in this packet. Preserve their accepted status/scope; any branch depending on their detailed predicates stays wholly held, rather than treating historical pending proposals as accepted or assuming universal immunity. Actual included Protection from Scrying is a valid positive comparison and blocks this Divination information within its exact scope.
rules.lifecycle: Instantaneous original snapshot only. A later entrant,exit,suppression change or recast creates no replay of this event. An actual interrupt preventing manifestation creates no display; actual source suppression/protection acts only at its qualified checkpoint. A new paid cast gets new saves and current facts without changing those facts. No concentration or persistent aura is added.

rules.recipientClock: NEW self-only pending insight record,nonconcentration,one hour/3600elapsed seconds from manifestation or until consumed. This openly resolves Gain as self wording; native120ft remains preserved source metadata and grants no transfer to another creature. Source death/removal ends the unused record; ordinary unconsciousness does not automatically erase it. One pending same-name record per creature: only a successfully manifested new source replaces the old, with a fresh paid deadline; a countered new cast leaves the old record. No stacking,token transfer or resurrection of a consumed source.
rules.rollScope: Select source option0 expressly: NEW numeric boundary is one legitimate own d20 attack,saving throw,ability/skill/tool/opposed orinitiative roll. Damage,healing,random tables,world-generation draws,passive scores,automatic outcomes and another creature's roll are excluded, rather than silently treated as Guidance. Full+10 applies to the one selected d20 event. No permission to attempt an impossible action or roll an otherwise automatic task. This local category boundary is authorship, not recovered native text. Death saves are expressly included by the bounded prior-declaration policy below; their natural1/20 special outcomes stay dominant.
rules.declaration: Consume the live unsuppressed pending record before the first candidate die of the chosen original roll is generated. No Action or Reaction is added or spent for this choice. A conscious competent owner can declare at that existing pre-roll decision point. Alternatively, at casting the owner may fix one exact automatic predicate: next own attack, next own saving throw, next own ability check, next own initiative, or next own death save. An automatic predicate consumes only on its first qualifying actually generated roll; it cannot inspect hidden dice/DCs, change later while incapacitated or create a roll. The explicitly selected next-death-save policy can apply while Dying/Unconscious; no ordinary conscious choice is inferred then. Later new policy requires a new actual cast, not a free rewrite.
rules.resolution: Attach insightFlat10 to the immutable original roll ID and its replacement lineage. Advantage/disadvantage selects its final candidate,then normal modifiers and this+10 apply once. A genuine authorized reroll/replacement keeps the original attached bonus without another use or+10 addition; only final consequences occur. A fresh independent roll receives none. Natural attack1 still misses and20 critically doubles only actual damage dice,not the flat insight or damage modifiers. Saves use final total without generic natural shifts; on death saves natural1 still adds two failures and natural20 still restores1HP, otherwise compare total including10 against10. Wound saves retain actual pre-Wound CON penalty and DC; the bonus does not remove an existing Wound.
rules.stacking: Same-name copies never stack. Under the included strongest-applicable same-stat flat-bonus rule use the strongest qualifying flat bonus in the same comparison family; this+10 is not added to another weaker competing flat insight bonus. Genuine distinct source dice benefits may apply only within their exact one-bonus-die/source rules. Core ability/PB modifiers are the base formula, not displaced by the insight. Reserve/consume at legal declaration even if its flat amount is superseded by a stronger existing benefit; do not reclaim it after failure. Source-qualified suppression disallows declaration but does not pause deadline or refund a consumed lineage. Once attached to a committed roll its snapshot persists through reroll/source ending; no suppression hook rewrites already committed dice.
rules.information: The benefit supplies a number only. It does not expose a hidden attack,DC,modifier,save reason,future die or result; automatic predicates operate without a public eligibility leak. Actual class rerolls keep their own permissions. Fate permissions still require their exact DE4 guard and presentation policy; this spell adds no presentation whitelist.

rules.establish: KEEP communicate with any creature; NEW one selected actually perceived creature within120ft and physical LoE on the same actual plane,concentration60elapsed seconds. Type names alone give no immunity; actual source-qualified mental/communication defenses still apply. Establishment needs no target assent or save unless an actual protection says otherwise. The recipient can ignore every message and decline every reply. A missing receptive mind is not invented; an unknown mind/cognition premise holds the dependent delivery branch. Source acquires no creature,ally status or command entitlement.
rules.messages: NEW voluntary two-way mental exchange. Each participant gets at most one intentionally composed brief utterance or simple impression in each of the ten original six-second source intervals[0,6),...,[54,60). A declared send consumes that direction’s current interval opportunity even if delivery is blocked, ignored or not understood; it never queues or grants an acknowledgement. No extra Action,Bonus Action,Reaction or companion phase is created. The expression uses that participant's real ordinary brief communication capacity; it does not grant compressed document/memory dumps. Any extraordinary bandwidth/image-complexity claim without an actual expression profile stays held. Messages contain only what the sender voluntarily chooses from its actual knowledge or imagination; claims may be lies or errors. Multiple overlapping channels do not multiply a body's ordinary communication capacity; one expression can be directed to one channel, with original source interval ledgers retained.
rules.comprehension: NEW concept/imagery adaptation expresses the sender's chosen meaning in a form the actual recipient can understand; a shared spoken language is not required. It teaches no extra language,Intelligence,mathematics or hidden fact, and reads no unchosen thought or memory. A simple creature can receive/convey only its actual concepts and impressions; no numeric Intelligence cutoff or invented animal profile. A genuinely absent or unconscious receptive mind receives nothing,does not awaken and supplies no dreams; suspend exchange while a living unconscious party remains, retaining deadline. Recipient ignorance,refusal,misunderstanding and deception remain possible. No acknowledgement is automatically returned to the sender.
rules.path: NEW maintain the actual120ft distance,same plane and physical LoE throughout each send/receive. An opaque solid barrier blocks this mental source at establishment and later delivery; this is an explicit local choice, not an inference from audible Message. Ordinary Silence/Deafened does not block already-established mental exchange or waive this spell's own initial V. Loss of path/range or source-qualified suppression suspends new exchange while the original clock and already-spent opportunities continue. Re-entry/restoration grants no extra interval/message and no queued past message. The source reports no distance,location,plane identity,blocker or secret reason to either party.
rules.limitsAndEnd: No mind reading,forced attention/reply,truth test,identity authentication,perfect secrecy against an actually authorized interceptor,mental command authority or remote sensory feed. A voluntary sender label is a claim. Telepathy is not audible speech,V,hearing or an extra command budget; a separately acquired command accepts it only if its actual channel predicate permits. New concentration ends old source at commitment,even if the new spell is countered. Either participant death/removal,source end,concentration loss or60second expiry terminates this link. Delivered memories remain; no replay on recast. Protection from Scrying does not block Universal communication solely by theme; exact Mind Blank/other missing protection details stay held.

rules.history: KEEP you and one ally repeat the FULL previous round. NEW caster plus one distinct actually willing,perceived allied creature within120ft/LoE at resolution; never select self twice. At ordinary commitment snapshot each actor's complete immutable log for the immediately preceding completed numbered round, not merely its last turn. Include all Action,Bonus Action,Reaction,voluntary movement segments,interactions,commands,extra-action/extra-turn events and the provenance of each, including failed/declined/zero-result committed attempts. Account for each entry as eligible,explicitly excluded or unavailable; do not silently trim the log. Source-defined forced movement,automatic damage,ticks,saves/death saves,environmental events and third-party acts are retained as context,not voluntary acts to regenerate. Outside initiative use the preceding complete fixed six-second world interval from an already established epoch; establish actual initiative before hostile replay. Missing or disputed complete history is a whole-case hold. Ready freezes the completed-round selection at paid preparation; later release never substitutes a newer round.
rules.phaseBudget: NEW explicit source-specific exception to the shared extra-full-Action cap: after the instantaneous outer resolves, run one finite caster phase then one finite ally phase in immutable historical order, before resuming ordinary queue progression. Each eligible historical Action/BA/Reaction entry supplies exactly one echo entitlement of that type; movement entry supplies no more than its historical paid movement cost,also capped by the current actual locomotion Speed for that entry. These entitlements are separate from normal current wallets,not a refill or another regular/extra turn. They can exceed the ordinary one-extra-full-Action slot ONLY for these fixed replay entries; no discretionary substitutions. Normal Action/BA/Reaction/movement/extra-slot records remain unchanged except the outer cast's actual Action or genuine independently chosen ordinary interrupts. No START/END,recharge,death save,rest,turn-only feature window or companion phase is created. Both phases must finish in this one serialized outer-resolution event,at the same elapsed timestamp before the enclosing regular slot resumes; micro-order is sequence only. No permission survives until a later turn.
rules.freshAttempts: Each entry uses the same actual acquired source,route,mode and fixed magnitudes/optional settings,with current body,stats,components,inventory and independent uses. It is a new attempt,with a new child eventID and fresh permitted RNG,not duplication of an old result. New targets/destinations may be selected through the original source's own range/consent/target-count rules. Movement starts from actual current position on a new legal path with no more historical cost; no teleport to old coordinates,refill of ordinary movement or illegal mode. Known unavailable predicates consume that entry without commitment/payment; hidden prevention after a legal commitment retains actual costs. Pay every current RP/material/charge,use and current Dissonance surcharge chronologically. No reservation of funds that do not exist,no negative balance,no restored items/HP/position,old payments or cooldown. Starting a child concentration really ends the old at commitment even if the child is countered.
rules.reactions: A historical Reaction entry is eligible only if its own REAL trigger is open at its ordered opportunity. No old trigger is assumed to happen again. If a fresh outsider response to the just-completed preceding replay entry opens that exact trigger, resolve this next pending historical Reaction node there before that triggering consequence. Otherwise consume it as no-current-trigger; do not wait,bank,reorder it past later history or invent an attack. A current ordinary Reaction may still be used independently through its real wallet; never charge both wallets for the same response. Outsiders use ordinary genuine Reaction/Ready windows and real resources; no extra enemy turn is supplied. Replayed attacks may provoke real consequences only within their own source rules.
rules.lineage: NEW finite no-recursion gate: exclude Time Echo,all copy/replay-descended payloads,and entries whose operative result grants further actions/turns/casting access,resource-loop or copy permissions. This includes actual Fate Echo,Echo Cast,Mirrorsage releases,feat copies and their generated payload descendants,never by a guessed name alone. Keep excluded nodes and reasons in the complete log. Explicit distinction: a separately chosen ordinary original action previously paid from a lawful Haste extra slot is not a copied payload; its own bounded action can repeat once, but repeating Haste's action-granting cast itself is excluded and no present Haste slot is refreshed. An ambiguous grant/copy ancestry without an exact adapter is a whole dependent branch hold. Intrinsic ordinary healing,summoning,protection or information is not forbidden merely because it could enable a later independent act; preserve actual shared limits and full source lifecycle.
